name: QA SDK Registry Server - Tests & Infrastructure
description: TypeScript + Hono + PostgreSQL 기반 Registry Server의 테스트 스위트, DB 마이그레이션, 로컬 개발 인프라를 구축한다. 서비스/이벤트 CRUD와 event_version 자동 발급 로직의 정확성을 검증한다.

userStories.title: Test infrastructure and Docker Compose setup
userStories.description: As a developer, I need vitest configured and a local PostgreSQL instance so that I can run unit and integration tests.
acceptanceCriteria: vitest and @vitest/coverage-v8 added as devDependencies in packages/registry-server/package.json
vitest.config.ts created at packages/registry-server/ with proper TypeScript and path resolution
package.json scripts include: 'test' (vitest run), 'test:watch' (vitest), 'test:coverage' (vitest run --coverage), 'typecheck' (tsc --noEmit)
docker-compose.yml created at packages/registry-server/ with PostgreSQL 16 service (port 5433 to avoid conflicts, db: qa_registry_test, user: postgres, password: postgres)
A placeholder test file src/__tests__/health.test.ts exists that verifies GET /health returns { ok: true } using Hono's app.request() (no DB needed)
pnpm --filter @qa-sdk/registry-server test passes with the placeholder test
pnpm --filter @qa-sdk/registry-server typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Use app.request() from hono for unit-level route testing without starting the server. The health test does not need a DB connection.

userStories.title: Drizzle DB migration generation
userStories.description: As a developer, I need SQL migration files generated from the Drizzle schema so that I can set up the database deterministically.
acceptanceCriteria: drizzle/ directory contains a generated SQL migration file for the initial schema
Migration SQL includes CREATE TABLE services with all columns, constraints, and checks matching src/db/schema.ts
Migration SQL includes CREATE TABLE service_events with all columns, FK, unique constraint, indices, and checks matching src/db/schema.ts
drizzle/meta/ directory contains the migration metadata JSON
db:generate script in package.json successfully produces the migration from the current schema
pnpm --filter @qa-sdk/registry-server typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Run 'pnpm --filter @qa-sdk/registry-server db:generate' to produce the migration. Ensure DATABASE_URL is set or use dotenv for drizzle-kit. Verify the generated SQL is correct by inspecting the output file.

userStories.title: Unit tests for EventService
userStories.description: As a developer, I need unit tests for the event module business logic including version auto-increment with mocked dependencies.
acceptanceCriteria: src/__tests__/modules/events/event.service.test.ts exists
EventRepository, ServiceRepository, and Db (transaction) are mocked
Test create(): first event for a key gets event_version '001'
Test create(): subsequent event for same key gets incremented version ('002', '003')
Test create(): throws SERVICE_NOT_FOUND when serviceId doesn't exist
Test create(): throws EVENT_VERSION_OVERFLOW when latest version is '999'
Test create(): verifies advisory lock is acquired before version read
Test getVersions(): returns EventVersionList with all versions sorted
Test getVersions(): throws SERVICE_NOT_FOUND when service doesn't exist
Test getVersions(): throws EVENT_NOT_FOUND when no events found for key
Test getByVersion(): returns EventWithServiceName when found
Test getByVersion(): throws EVENT_NOT_FOUND when version doesn't exist
Test update(): happy path returns updated event
Test update(): throws EVENT_NOT_FOUND when eventId doesn't exist
All tests pass with pnpm --filter @qa-sdk/registry-server test
pnpm --filter @qa-sdk/registry-server typecheck passes
userStories.notes: The db.transaction() mock is the trickiest part. Mock it so the callback receives a tx that acts like EventRepository. The advisory lock (acquireAdvisoryLock) should be a no-op in the mock.

userStories.title: Integration test for concurrent event version creation
userStories.description: As a developer, I need a test that verifies concurrent event creation produces unique sequential versions via advisory lock.
acceptanceCriteria: src/__tests__/integration/concurrency.test.ts exists
Test fires 5 concurrent POST /services/:serviceId/events requests with the same event_key using Promise.all()
All 5 requests succeed with status 201 (no duplicates or errors)
The 5 returned event_versions are exactly ['001','002','003','004','005'] (unique and sequential)
No two events share the same event_version for the same (service_id, event_key)
Test fires 3 concurrent requests for event_key_a and 3 for event_key_b simultaneously, verifying each key gets independent 001-003 sequences
All tests pass with pnpm --filter @qa-sdk/registry-server test
pnpm --filter @qa-sdk/registry-server typecheck passes
userStories.notes: This test validates the pg_advisory_xact_lock mechanism. Uses real DB transactions, not mocks. If advisory lock is working correctly, all concurrent inserts should get unique versions without unique constraint violations.
